item.title: AI Techniques for Performance, Reliability, and Sustainability of Modern Software Systems
item.content:encoded:
This special issue invites research on the application of artificial intelligence methods to improve key aspects of modern software systems. The focus encompasses using AI to enhance system performance, increase reliability, and promote sustainability in software engineering and operations.

Appel publié par Journal of Systems and Software. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
